Games Action Games Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 What we know about GTA 6 animals so far Guides By Iain Wilson Published 30 October 2026 There will be over 170 different animal species in GTA 6, and this is what has been confirmed about them When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here's how it works . (Image credit: Rockstar) Jump To: GTA 6 animals list Rare, Discoverable, and Legendary animals Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter GTA 6 animals are going to represent the broadest zoological spread ever seen in a Rockstar game, with a diverse selection of over 170 different species represented. This includes more than 60 types of bird, over 30 land mammals, plus a variety of reptiles, fish, and much more. Whether you find them in the wildernesses of GTA 6 or an enclosure in Leonida's own zoo there will be plenty to discover, so here's what we know so far about the animals in GTA 6. Visiting the zoo is one of many GTA 6 side activities available, but if you want a quiet trip then you'll need to lose your GTA 6 Wanted Level first. GTA 6 animals list (Image credit: Rockstar Games) Through a combination of trailers, screenshots, and previews there are already plenty of GTA 6 animals that we know about. These include: Alligator Bald Eagle Bear Cane toad Cat (domestic and feral) Cougar Cow Deer Dog (various breeds) Dolphin Duck Flamingo Frog Green iguana Jellyfish Manatee Manta ray Nine-banded armadillo Pelican Pigeon Raccoon Rat Rhesus macaque monkey Sea turtle Seagull Shark (various species) Snake Whale Whooping Crane The variety of creatures includes both expected wildlife for each area and invasive species, reflecting the diversity seen in real-life Florida. Each will have accurate movement animations following significant research, and are going to look more realistic than ever before thanks to additions such as iridescence, bioluminescence, translucency, and even different types of feathers. Coats and pelts have also been upgraded, with new hair and fur systems offering color variations, appearance changes when wet, and dirt matting picked up from the environment. Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: (Image credit: Rockstar Games) As seen during the Extended Look, you'll be presented with a choice of interactions when you approach GTA 6 animals and they'll respond accordingly. When Jason encounters a dog in the apartment complex, he has the option to Praise it from a distance then either Scold or Pet the dog when up close. Importantly, there is also an option to Study the animal, which will then add it to your compendium in a similar way to Red Dead Redemption 2, and there are likely to be rewards for filling in your logbook with the creatures you investigate. Rare, Discoverable, and Legendary animals (Image credit: Rockstar Games) In addition to the general GTA 6 animal species that you'll encounter around Leonida, Rockstar have confirmed that there will also be plenty of unusual creatures that you can track, in a similar way to the Red Dead Redemption series. These will be divided into Rare , Discoverable , and Legendary categories, but beyond that they are staying tight-lipped on details for now as they want players to make surprising discoveries for themselves while they explore.
